subject: CPPO activation: reseller POC evidence, entitlement mapping & billing path
messages:
From: Emma Liu <emma@cloudresellco.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: aws-cpg-east@amazon.com, procurement@cloudresellco.com
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: CPPO activation + POC evidence and billing path for CloudResellCo

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — CloudResellCo is excited to pilot Redwood on a CPPO flow. To get the AWS private offer set up we need the standard CPPO evidence bundle (SOC links, entitlements mapping, SOW template) and a clear mapping of how subscription entitlements will route into our billing system. Procurement also requested a short schedule for a 2-week POC so they can align PO timing.

Can you share: 1) a one-page evidence bundle we can attach to our internal CPPO submission to AWS, 2) the entitlement matrix (SKU -> customer entitlement), and 3) a proposed POC start window (we prefer 5/26–6/6)?

We also need to know whether invoice flows will be direct from AWS (marketplace billing) or if CloudResellCo will be the payor under the resell arrangement — clarity here affects our PO.

Appreciate quick confirmation so I can brief procurement.

Best,
Emma Liu
Head of Partnerships
CloudResellCo
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Emma Liu <emma@cloudresellco.com>, aws-cpg-east@amazon.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: CPPO activation + POC evidence and billing path for CloudResellCo

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear asks. Looping in Ben (partner ops) and Vanessa (billing lead) to confirm evidence and the invoicing paths. Priyom from the reseller enablement team will take the entitlement mapping and POC schedule.

Quick answers up front:
- We can produce a 1-pager evidence bundle and a SOC 2 link by EOD Friday (5/16).
- Entitlement matrix: Priyom will draft SKU -> entitlement mappings and share a CSV for your ingestion.
- POC window: 5/26–6/6 looks doable; we suggest kickoff week of 5/26 with a 10-business-day test.
- Billing: two options — (A) AWS Marketplace billing direct to CloudResellCo as the payor (marketplace flow), or (B) CloudResellCo as resell payor with monthly reconciliation via private offer settlement. Vanessa, can you confirm implications for invoicing and if we need a billing SOW?

Attaching a reference entitlement_matrix.csv and a short billing-path diagram (stubs attached). Will follow up with the evidence zip and SOW template.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Sr. Partnerships Manager, Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: CPPO activation + POC evidence and billing path for CloudResellCo

Got it — quick ops notes:
- I'll prep a concise evidence bundle (SOC 2 link, data retention statement, KMS attestations) and push to the Drive folder by 5/16 COB.
- For the entitlement matrix, Priyom, please include columns: Redwood SKU, AWS private-offer SKU (if different), entitlement type (seat/usage), customer mapping field, and any required customer metadata.
- On billing: Vanessa, if we go with marketplace billing direct to CloudResellCo, they will receive AWS invoices; the private-offer settlement still needs reconciliation for partner margin. If resell payor, we need reseller payor NIT/Tax entity mapping — I can share our standard template.

I'll also be the backup to respond to AWS questions on evidence.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Partner Operations, Redwood Inference
From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Emma Liu <emma@cloudresellco.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 15 May 2025 08:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Entitlement matrix + POC schedule (draft)

Hi Emma — attaching the draft entitlement_matrix.csv and a proposed POC runbook in the Drive link. Summary:
- We mapped three SKUs: RED-GEN (pay-per-token), RED-EMB (embedding units), RED-DED (dedicated capacity). Columns include Redwood SKU, suggested AWS private-offer SKU, entitlement_type, metadata keys (customer_id, org_unit).
- Proposed POC timetable: kickoff 2025-05-27, baseline tests 05/28–06/05, wrap and exec readout 06/06.
- Risk: if CloudResellCo requires reseller-payor instead of marketplace-bill, procurement will need ~7 business days for internal approval.

Please review the CSV; leave comments on the Drive doc and I'll update.

Attachments: entitlement_matrix.csv (stub), POC-runbook.md (stub)

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Reseller Enablement, Redwood Inference
From: David Zhang (AWS CPPO) <aws-cpg-east@amazon.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, Emma Liu <emma@cloudresellco.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Request: CPPO activation + POC evidence and billing path for CloudResellCo

Hi all — thanks for the materials. A few points from AWS:
1) Evidence: the 1-pager and SOC 2 link are sufficient to open the CPPO case. Please attach the KMS/HSM attestation if available.
2) Entitlements: private-offer SKUs must align to the listing SKUs in AWS; if you plan to create alias SKUs, supply the mapping CSV at time of submit.
3) Billing/payor: for a reseller-payor flow we need a payor entity ID and tax information at time of offer activation; that will delay activation by ~5 business days for verification.

Next steps recommended: Laura/Ben — submit the CPPO case with the evidence zip and the mapping CSV by 5/22 so we can target activation before CloudResellCo's requested POC start of 5/27. If reseller wants to be payor, please include payor entity details with procurement paperwork to avoid last-minute holds.

Regards,
David Zhang
AWS Channel Private Offer (CPPO) Team
